claim: Let \(m_{\mathrm{FPP}}(S^1)\) be the least cardinality of a finite \(T_0\)-space with the fixed point property and weak homotopy type \(S^1\). Then \(10 \le m_{\mathrm{FPP}}(S^1) \le 14\).

integrity.claim_scope: minimum cardinality for finite T0 fixed-point spaces of weak homotopy type S1
integrity.lower_bound_chain: Rutkowski small-set theorem -> connected collapsibility -> Baclawski pseudo-cone contractibility -> McCord order-complex weak equivalence

scientific_limitations: The exact minimum is not determined; cardinalities 10 through 14 remain possible.
The direct full text of Rutkowski (1989) was unavailable during verification; the at-most-nine connected-collapse statement was verified through Schröder's explicit restatement.
Noncoverage searches do not constitute a proof of novelty; the contribution is a synthesis bound.
title: A width-four cardinality window for finite fixed-point models of the circle
